name: aitmpl
description: /aitmpl opens a side pane that looks like VS Code's Extensions view: a search box, quick filters for the aitmpl.com component types, an Installed section (agents, commands, skills and mods found in .claude/ and ~/.claude/), a Popular/Results list with download counts, and a button on every row that opens the component's page. A row's name opens its detail with install ($.process.run with the fixed CLI argv and a validated path, no shell) and put-command-in-prompt. The catalog is read live from the site's public JSON through $.http.fetch; browsing costs no tokens.

siteUrl.title: Site URL
siteUrl.description: The site whose public catalog JSON is browsed (counts.json, components/{type}.json)

pageSize.title: Rows per page
pageSize.description: Rows shown per section before "show more"

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane in the fullscreen layout (28-120); a width you drag it to wins
